name: Thick Fat
source:
A pokemon trainer gets lost in an icy area while looking for new pokemon to catch, and ends up needing some rescuing. Thankfully, someone is around to share some body heat.

[From [url=https://mrtomatoesquire.itch.io/thick-fat]Itch.io[/url]]

一名神奇宝贝训练师在寻找新的神奇宝贝来捕捉时在冰天雪地中迷路，最终需要救援。值得庆幸的是，有人在身边分享一些体温。
